tools.name: DigitalEye-Mammography
tools.description: A comprehensive toolkit for breast mass detection and classification in mammograms.
features: Detects breast masses and classifies them as benign or malignant.
Supports multiple state-of-the-art detection models (ATSS, Cascade R-CNN, DETR, YOLOv3, etc.).
Performs breast segmentation preprocessing.
Supports model ensemble for enhanced accuracy.
Outputs bounding boxes, confidence scores, and classification results.

tools.name: FactCheXcker_CarinaNet
tools.description: An AI tool for carina and endotracheal tube (ETT) detection and distance measurement in chest X-rays.
features: Automatically detects the carina and ETT tip.
Measures the distance between them (mm, cm, or pixels).
Determines if ETT placement is too high, too low, or correct.
Generates clinical reports and annotated visualizations.
Provides confidence scores and structured clinical assessments.

tools.name: Gemma (MedGemma CLI)
tools.description: A multimodal medical visual question answering (VQA) system using the Gemma 3 + SigLIP model.
features: Automatically identifies the input image modality (X-ray, MRI, CT, ultrasound, pathology, etc.).
Analyzes and interprets medical images in response to natural-language questions.
Provides detailed and clinically plausible answers.
Supports standard formats (JPG, PNG, DICOM, NIfTI, etc.).
Useful for descriptive image interpretation, anomaly identification, and anatomical reasoning.

tools.name: TotalSegmentator
tools.description: An open-source tool for automatic segmentation of over 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR images.
features: Performs full-body, lung-vessel, or MR-specific segmentation.
Outputs multi-label or organ-wise segmentation masks.
Supports organ volumetry, radiomics feature extraction, and statistical analysis.
Can run in fast mode for lower-resolution inference.
Commonly used for surgical planning and disease characterization.

tools.name: ChestXRayAnatomySegmentation (CXAS)
tools.description: A tool for fine-grained anatomical segmentation and feature extraction in chest radiographs.
features: Segments up to 157 thoracic anatomical structures (heart, lungs, ribs, spine, etc.).
Extracts clinical metrics such as Cardio-Thoracic Ratio (CTR) and Spine-Center Distance (SCD).
Uses volumetric pseudo-labeling with CT projection for precision.
Operates in segmentation or feature extraction mode.
Outputs segmentation masks, CSV files, and quantitative measurements.
tools.notes: Can compute only one metric (either CTR or SCD) per invocation; split tasks if both are needed.

tools.name: TorchXrayVision
tools.description: A deep learning library for chest X-ray classification, segmentation, and feature analysis.
features: Provides pre-trained models trained on datasets (NIH, CheXpert, MIMIC-CXR, etc.).
Detects pathologies such as pneumonia, effusion, cardiomegaly, atelectasis, and pneumothorax.
Outputs probability-based and binary classification results.
Supports batch inference, pathology localization, and distribution shift analysis.
Useful for chest disease screening and radiology AI research.
